title: Precision, Units and Measurement Problems
introduction: Develop mathematical understanding through precision, units and measurement problems.
definition: Measured quantities have limited precision. A value rounded to the nearest unit is within half a unit of the recorded value, with the upper midpoint excluded under ordinary rounding up. Convert units consistently and distinguish length, area and volume.

examples.question: A length is recorded as 12 cm to the nearest centimetre.
steps: Half a centimetre on either side gives the rounding interval.

exercises.question: Lower boundary for 7 cm rounded to nearest cm?
Maximum rounding error bound to nearest 10?
